title: Former Deloitte, EY partners join UpGrad to set up advisory business
summary: UpGrad hires former Deloitte and EY partners to establish advisory business
detailed: Former Deloitte partners Anandorup Ghose and Krishna Chaitanya Malladi, former EY partner Hrishikesh Godbole and former Deloitte executive Dinkar Pawan are joining as managing directors of the new vertical, UpGrad Next. More senior consulting executives are likely to join over the next few weeks.
